title: Microsoft.Azure.ServiceBus is deprecated on NuGet
summary: NuGet marks all 33 listed versions of Microsoft.Azure.ServiceBus as deprecated (reason: Legacy). The publisher's message: "Please note, this package is obsolete as of 9/30/2026 and is no longer maintained or monitored. Microsoft encourages you to upgrade to the replacement package, Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus, to continue receiving updates. Refer to the migration guide (https://aka.ms/azsdk/net/migrate/sb) for guidance on upgrading. Refer to our deprecation policy (https://aka.ms/azsdk/support-policies) for more details."

constraints: Keep the namespace, queue, topic, and subscription names the same; only the client library changes.
Read the migration guide first: message settlement, sessions, and retry options moved to ServiceBusClient, ServiceBusSender, ServiceBusReceiver, and ServiceBusProcessor.

steps.title: Move to Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus
steps.instructions: Replace Microsoft.Azure.ServiceBus with Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus and update QueueClient, TopicClient, and SubscriptionClient code to ServiceBusClient with senders, receivers, or processors.

verification.purpose: Build and test after the client library change.
